definitions.SNR: 10*log10(P_reference / P_noise); P_reference = variance of the raw recording
definitions.baseline_drift: sum of 4 sinusoids [0.05, 0.5] Hz + slow ramp
definitions.emg_like: band-pass [20.0, 200.0] Hz noise with bursty envelope (SYNTHETIC, not real EMG)
definitions.ocular_like: Poisson blink-like Gaussian pulses (width ~0.25 s, rate 0.30/s) + [0.5, 4.0] Hz eye-movement-like noise (SYNTHETIC)
